system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 240 ft, Tremorsense 120 ft in water
system.tactics: A Leviathan is a moving disaster rather than a normal predator. It ### Attacks ships, coastal fortifications, and anything that disturbs the deep. It opens with Call of the Deep, breaks the vessel with Shipbreaker, and devours creatures attempting to escape. It does not pursue prey far from its territory once the threat has been destroyed.
system.attacksNotes:
Devouring Maw [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 8), Reach: 20 ft

  • Margin 1:: 22 damage (14 + 8 Str)
  • Margin 2: 22 damage, DR halved (round up); target is Grappled and pulled into the maw

Colossal Tail [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 8) against every creature within 20 feet behind the Leviathan

  • Margin 1:: 22 damage (14 + 8 Str); target is pushed 20 ft
  • Margin 2: 22 damage, DR halved (round up); target is pushed 40 ft and knocked Prone

Multiattack [Combat]: The Leviathan makes one Devouring Maw attack and one Colossal Tail attack. Shared Attribute Roll (Agil 5): Roll Agility once and apply it to both ### Attacks.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: World-Turning Wake: When the Leviathan moves through water, it creates a 30-foot-wide wake. Creatures and unsecured objects in the wake make a Reflex save or are pushed 30 feet, knocked Prone, and take 8 bludgeoning damage. A successful save halves the damage and movement. Shipbreaker: The Leviathan's ### Attacks deal double damage to vessels, structures, and other objects. A vessel reduced to 0 HP begins sinking immediately. Call of the Deep (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Every creature that can hear the Leviathan within 120 feet makes a Will save. On a failure, it gains Frightened and must use its next [Move] action to approach the water or the Leviathan. On a success, it is immune to this Leviathan's Call of the Deep for 24 hours. Aquatic Body: The Leviathan can breathe water indefinitely. On land, it moves at half speed and adds 1 to both attack dice, but it cannot use World-Turning Wake. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
